WHAT THIS REMAINDER CHANGED:
(1) src/vb_mutants.zig:321 — the last /tmp-reading test in the suite (M10 alias-control null). It read /tmp/weizigo/oracle-2x2-exhaustive.smd1; it now calls vb_i11.fixtureExhaustive(2,2) (made pub) and vb_i11.freeFixture. Null-control semantics are unchanged: both the old on-disk dump and the regeneration come from the same kernel move generator, and the point of M10 is solver-vs-alias-of-solver vacuous agreement.
(2) src/vb_i11.zig header — A0004's claim 'build.zig has no vb_i11_tests target' was itself WRONG: build.zig has carried vb_i11_tests wired into test_step since T346 (build.zig:601-612 at 189e423). The header now states that, with the correction dated and sourced. What does NOT exist is a standalone named step; standalone runs use the zig test command documented in the header.

EVIDENCE, measured 2026-08-18 with /tmp/weizigo NONEXISTENT (ls: No such file or directory — it decayed during the operator's ten-day absence, as the 2026-08-08 handover predicted; the /tmp/weizigo/260707 archive is gone too, so the written cp stopgap was impossible and regeneration was the only path):

STILL UNVERIFIED, deliberately left so: A0004 item (3), the original author's 'byte-identity verified out-of-band' claim. The 114-record count and 0-mismatch null reads are behavioral equality on these consumers, NOT byte-identity of emitted files. Treat the port as a re-implementation until someone diffs bytes against a tools/smd1.zig emission.

REMAINING /tmp EXPOSURE, out of this row's scope and flagged to the storage-policy review: 46 other files under src/ and tools/ reference /tmp/weizigo (instruments t380-t419, regression shell scripts). Those are standalone instruments and script-local scratch, not zig-build-test members; the suite itself is now /tmp-free. The wider question of what belongs in /tmp vs untracked/ vs data/ vs tracked evidence — including that data/ (1.7 GB of oracle tables, among them the canonical oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2) is gitignored and exists on one disk with no known backup — is registered separately rather than smuggled into this row.

LANDMARK: advances L2 hygiene (proven values stay provable — the suite's null controls no longer depend on state a tmp sweep deletes). The loss this row repairs was the project's own: T423's housekeeping moved fixtures nobody's build step owned, and the suite went red for a reason no source change explains.
